caption:
Six things office workers try to claim. How many would you get right?

Gym: no (unless strenuous physical activity is an essential, regular part of your job). Laptop with 60% work use: yes, but only the work share, spread over its effective life because it cost more than $300. Plain black pants: no. Union fees: yes. Driving from home to the office: no. Last year's tax agent fee: yes, in the year you paid it.

For 2025–26 returns.

Comment CLAIM and you'll be first to get The Claim Sheet when it lands in December.

General info only, not personal advice.

#taxtips #taxreturn #officelife #australiantax #taxdeductions
figures_checked: Gym/fitness not deductible except where strenuous physical activity is essential and regular (ATO Gym fees page, checked 1 Nov 2026)
Depreciating assets: $300 or less immediate deduction, over $300 decline in value over effective life, apportion work use (ATO Depreciating assets you use for work, checked 1 Nov 2026)
Conventional clothing and normal home-to-work trips not deductible; union fees deductible (ATO public servant toolkit, checked 1 Nov 2026)
Registered tax agent fees deductible in year paid (ATO Cost of managing tax affairs, checked 1 Nov 2026)
Union/professional fees don't reduce the 2026-27 standard deduction (ATO standard deduction page, checked 1 Nov 2026)
Same figures as RP-02 (re-cut of its slides)
